verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents its own out-of-office handling: a vacation/holiday/out-of-office help article and automatic OOO visibility. It also shares availability through Scheduling Links and supports date-specific No-Meeting Days via the #reclaim_free hashtag, which loosely approximates date overrides. However, the pack never documents configurable working hours or a structured availability-schedule editor with per-date overrides. Missing for 10: explicit working-hours configuration, a formal date-override feature beyond hashtag-based no-meeting days, detailed OOO setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods

citations.quote: you may also want Reclaim to continue scheduling your Tasks and Habits during that period of time. Reclaim supports both of these use cases.
you can set a smart No-Meeting Day using the hashtag #reclaim_free.
